name: Domain Search for WHMCS
author: Shipon Karmakar

sections.description:
Domain Search for WHMCS provides a simple way to add a domain search form to your WordPress website that redirects users to your WHMCS installation for domain registration. This lightweight plugin doesn’t require any complex integration – just add your WHMCS URL in the settings, place the shortcode where you want the search form to appear, and the plugin will handle redirecting users to the appropriate WHMCS domain registration page.

Features

  • Clean and responsive domain search form
  • Easy integration with shortcode
  • Customizable placeholder text
  • Custom CSS support
  • Direct integration with WHMCS domain registration
  • Mobile-friendly design

Usage

Simply add the shortcode [whmcs_domain_search] to any post or page where you want the domain search form to appear.

Configuration

  1. Navigate to Settings > Domain Search for WHMCS
  2. Enter your WHMCS URL
  3. Customize the search placeholder text
  4. Add any custom CSS if needed
  5. Save your changes

Additional Notes

For support or feature requests, please visit the plugin’s WordPress.org support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/whmcs-domain-search directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings > Domain Search for WHMCS screen to configure the plugin
  4. Use the shortcode [whmcs_domain_search] in your posts or pages
sections.faq:
How do I display the search form?

Use the shortcode [whmcs_domain_search] in any post or page where you want the form to appear.

Can I customize the form’s appearance?

Yes, you can add custom CSS through the plugin settings page to modify the form’s appearance.

How does this plugin work with WHMCS?

This plugin provides a search form on your WordPress site that redirects users to your WHMCS installation for domain registration. You only need the URL of your WHMCS installation – no direct WHMCS integration or local WHMCS installation is required.
